structures.name: Inferior vena cava
structures.note: The IVC runs posterior to the liver and receives the hepatic veins.

structures.name: Main portal vein
structures.note: The main portal vein enters at the porta hepatis and divides into right and left branches.

structures.name: Left hepatic vein and branches
structures.note: The left hepatic vein drains the left liver toward the IVC.

structures.name: Middle hepatic vein and branches
structures.note: The middle hepatic vein follows the principal plane separating functional right and left liver.

structures.name: Right hepatic vein and branches
structures.note: The right hepatic vein marks the right intersegmental plane and drains to the IVC.

structures.name: Left portal vein and branches
structures.note: The left portal vein supplies the left liver and gives rise to segmental branches.

structures.name: Right portal vein and branches
structures.note: The right portal vein divides into anterior and posterior sectoral branches.

structures.name: Liver Segment II
structures.note: Segment II lies in the superior part of the left lateral section.

structures.name: Liver Segment III
structures.note: Segment III lies in the inferior part of the left lateral section.

structures.name: Liver Segment VI
structures.note: Segment VI is in the inferior posterior right liver.

structures.name: Liver Segment IVa
structures.note: Segment IVa occupies the superior medial left liver.

structures.name: Liver Segment IVb
structures.note: Segment IVb occupies the inferior medial left liver.

structures.name: Liver Segment I
structures.note: Segment I is the caudate lobe, posterior to the porta hepatis and close to the IVC.

structures.name: Liver Segment V
structures.note: Segment V is in the inferior anterior right liver.

structures.name: Liver Segment VII
structures.note: Segment VII is in the superior posterior right liver.

structures.name: Liver Segment VIII
structures.note: Segment VIII is anterosuperior in the right liver, between the middle and right hepatic veins; its portal branches course within the segment.

structures.name: Gallbladder
structures.note: The gallbladder lies along the inferior surface of the right liver near segments IVb and V.
